scope_note: The user-supplied counterfactual.md defined the branch. Claims were rechecked against primary papers and author-linked repositories. A repository is called official only when linked by the paper, project page, author, or availability statement.

papers.title: MedEinst: Benchmarking the Einstellung Effect in Medical LLMs through Counterfactual Differential Diagnosis
papers.code_status: Dataset/project shell only; ECR-Agent code is marked Coming Soon.
papers.logs_status: No model outputs or execution logs.
papers.supported_mechanism: The DCI bundle and the gold/critic-trained CGME bundle each add aggregate performance, but their internal graph, retrieval, shadow-evidence, teacher and memory effects are not separately identified.
papers.transfer: Present/Absent/Missing evidence roles, soft expected-evidence obligations and pair-specific retrieval.
papers.do_not_transfer: Hard missing-evidence penalties, unvalidated generated causal graphs, or gold/teacher memory represented as training-free causal inference.

papers.title: Improving Clinical Diagnosis with Counterfactual Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.code_status: Inference, prompts, providers and scoring are public; tests and experiment configuration are absent.
papers.logs_status: No committed experiment results or run logs.
papers.supported_mechanism: Removing the CF case-editing pathway while retaining the remaining multi-agent scaffold lowers accuracy in a 30-case ablation; the pathway's editing, rerun, filtering and scoring mediators remain unresolved.
papers.implementation_issue: Public CPG scores the diagnosis sequence actually generated by a candidate-match prompt on the baseline side and a free top-1 prompt on the edited side; neither a common label nor a common scoring task is guaranteed, and SIP candidate filtering fails open.
papers.transfer: Fixed-candidate signed margin interventions and explicit hypothesis challenge.
papers.do_not_transfer: Absolute CPG, free top-1 confidence comparison, fail-open realism filters, or full-case rewrites as evidence.

papers.title: Auditing Evidence Use in Medical LLM Diagnosis
papers.code_status: No code link in the paper and no official repository found in title/author search as of the research date.
papers.supported_mechanism: Frozen candidate margins plus low-order Mobius interactions expose support, competition, cancellation and negation misuse; robustness screens enrich a review queue.
papers.transfer: Offline singleton and low-order interaction audit over a frozen A:B margin.
papers.do_not_transfer: Treating behavioral attribution as causal truth, negative interaction as a veto, or exhaustive subset enumeration online.

papers.title: DeVisE: Towards the Behavioral Testing of Medical Large Language Models
papers.code_status: Counterfactual construction, inference and analysis scripts are public.
papers.logs_status: Expected output directories exist in documentation, but data, results and run logs are not committed.
papers.supported_mechanism: Single-variable paired perturbations reveal directional and monotonic response failures hidden by aggregate metrics; templates localize the changed signal. Table 3 and prose report slightly conflicting average direction rates.
papers.implementation_issue: SpO2 thresholds differ from the paper, blood-pressure generation changes two variables together, and the generator can create no-ops.
papers.transfer: Exact-offset minimal edits, post-diff validation, signed response curves and monotonicity tests.
papers.do_not_transfer: Assuming template gains are clinical diagnostic gains or accepting generated edits before no-op/multi-edit checks.

papers.title: Counterfactual Evaluation Reveals Hidden Capability Profiles in Clinical LLMs and Agents
papers.code_status: The paper describes a preregistered YAML intervention catalog but provides no accessible code artifact; no official repository was found.
papers.supported_mechanism: Pre-specified response direction measures evidence responsiveness not visible in coverage scores; access to the same chart section need not produce the correct update.
papers.transfer: Expected-sign edge tests with explicit no-op, coherence and appropriate-refusal states.
papers.do_not_transfer: Using CSS as a live rank score or treating low-agreement mutation-family rules as unquestioned clinical truth.

papers.title: MamaBench: Benchmarking LLM Robustness in Maternal and Child Health Diagnosis through Counterfactual Clinical Perturbation
papers.code_status: No code repository is linked and no official repository was found; the dataset is hosted on the authors' Hugging Face organization.
papers.supported_mechanism: The typed comparison scaffold is the largest isolated ablation gain; contrastive gap-fill adds benefit after the scaffold. Coverage auditing alone is inert.
papers.transfer: Typed discriminator coverage and retrieval only for a verified A:B evidence gap.
papers.do_not_transfer: Generic case-similarity retrieval, claiming coverage detection alone improves diagnosis, or fixed cap expansion without edge qualification.

papers.title: Faithfulness vs. Safety: Evaluating LLM Behavior Under Counterfactual Medical Evidence
papers.code_status: Dataset only; README states that code and model outputs will be released later.
papers.logs_status: No model outputs or evaluation logs.
papers.supported_mechanism: Formal and repeated contextual evidence can bind implausible entities into a treatment role and override prior/safety behavior; responsiveness is not inherently desirable.
papers.transfer: Independent provenance, entailment, clinical-plausibility and safety gates before evidence affects ranking.
papers.do_not_transfer: Maximizing evidence adherence or using parametric prior as an unconditional hard veto.

papers.title: MEDEXA: Enhancing Explainability in LLMs through Counterfactual Explanations, Uncertainty Estimation and Prompt Engineering
papers.code_status: LangGraph pipeline, retrieval, prompts and evaluation scripts are public.
papers.logs_status: Statistical scripts embed metric arrays; expected prediction results and raw responses are absent.
papers.supported_mechanism: Retrieval/grounding and final explanation orchestration may improve judged clarity/faithfulness; generated what-if prose is not applied and rerun as an intervention.
papers.transfer: Only a post-hoc switch-condition card after a real paired replay has validated the switch.
papers.do_not_transfer: Generated counterfactual prose or self-reported confidence as ranking evidence.

papers.title: Evaluation of causal reasoning for large language models in contextualized clinical scenarios of laboratory test interpretation
papers.code_status: Dataset, notebook dump and scripts are public; no SCM, DAG, do-calculus or abduction-action-prediction solver is implemented.
papers.logs_status: Published response-and-four-reviewer spreadsheet is present; advertised result/config directories are absent.
papers.supported_mechanism: Association, intervention and counterfactual tasks are empirically distinct; altered-outcome counterfactuals are especially fragile.
papers.implementation_issue: Public script calls gpt-4o whereas paper/README name GPT-o1 and uses hard-coded paths without a seed.
papers.transfer: Causal-rung labels and altered-outcome paired stress tests.
papers.do_not_transfer: Calling the benchmark taxonomy a causal inference algorithm or selector module.

papers.title: Benchmarking retrieval-augmented large language models in biomedical NLP: Application, robustness, and self-awareness
papers.code_status: Partial training/retrieval/evaluation scripts; the published contrastive method is not reproducible from current main.
papers.logs_status: Current main lacks most outputs; older commit c8045f2 retains MedMCQA inference logs. Comparisons must not mix its Llama3 no-example output with Llama2 counterfactual arms.
papers.supported_mechanism: Wrong retrieved labels can harm generation; explicit source/conflict awareness matters. Detect-and-correct gains use an external GPT-4 label repairer.
papers.implementation_issue: A negative-awareness construction script assigns the same label to true and fake noise; historical contamination response is non-monotonic.
papers.transfer: Retrieval provenance, corruption shams, contradiction quarantine and abstention.
papers.do_not_transfer: Treating corpus-label counterfactuals as patient counterfactuals or allowing a model to overwrite evidence labels without validation.

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList
papers.code_status: Full MFT, INV and DIR test framework, perturbation utilities and suites.
papers.logs_status: Release archive includes benchmark predictions; not inference logs for this project.
papers.supported_mechanism: Capability-by-test matrices and grouped expectations expose behavioral failures hidden by aggregate accuracy.
papers.transfer: Clinical MFT/INV/DIR gates over frozen candidate margins.
papers.do_not_transfer: Assuming test generation itself improves reasoning.

papers.title: Evaluating Models' Local Decision Boundaries via Contrast Sets
papers.code_status: Datasets, consistency evaluators and several model outputs are public.
papers.logs_status: Model output files are included for several tasks.
papers.supported_mechanism: Original-and-all-perturbations consistency measures local decision-boundary robustness rather than isolated accuracy.
papers.transfer: Case-family consistency and clinically authored minimal edits.
papers.do_not_transfer: Treating an off-manifold automatic edit as a valid clinical oracle.

papers.title: Learning the Difference that Makes a Difference with Counterfactually-Augmented Data
papers.code_status: Counterfactually augmented datasets only; training and annotation application are absent.
papers.supported_mechanism: Training on coherent label-flipping revisions shifts feature reliance away from correlated noncausal spans.
papers.transfer: Minimal-edit data specification for future audit or retraining.
papers.do_not_transfer: Claiming its training-dependent gain in a training-free inference round.

papers.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
papers.code_status: Mature exact, sampling, tree and other explainers with tests and documentation.
papers.logs_status: No logs relevant to the clinical pipelines.
papers.supported_mechanism: Coalition-value attribution explains a frozen model relative to a chosen masker/background.
papers.transfer: Offline low-dimensional coalition audit with value defined as frozen A:B margin.
papers.do_not_transfer: Interpreting SHAP value as a clinical likelihood ratio or causal effect.

papers.title: The Shapley Taylor Interaction Index
papers.code_status: No separate author-linked official implementation found; third-party implementations exist in SHAP/Archipelago materials.
papers.supported_mechanism: Axiomatic low-order allocation of coalition effects can separate main and interaction terms.
papers.transfer: Offline second/third-order interaction screen on a small frozen evidence set.
papers.do_not_transfer: Online exhaustive enumeration or causal interpretation under an arbitrary masker.

papers.title: How does This Interaction Affect Me? Interpretable Attribution for Feature Interactions
papers.code_status: Black-box finite-difference explainer, baselines, notebooks and result tables are public.
papers.logs_status: Experiment notebooks/tables, not clinical inference logs.
papers.supported_mechanism: Second-order finite differences in two contexts identify interacting feature groups with O(d^2) evaluations.
papers.transfer: Small offline pair-interaction audit for evidence synergy/cancellation.
papers.do_not_transfer: Treating interaction strength as clinical truth or using it as an unvalidated online rank weight.

papers.title: Integrated Directional Gradients: Feature Interaction Attribution for Neural NLP Models
papers.code_status: Gradient implementation, modified models and examples are public.
papers.logs_status: No logs relevant to this clinical task.
papers.supported_mechanism: Embedding-path gradients projected over linguistic groups attribute interactions when model weights and gradients are available.
papers.do_not_transfer: Direct use with black-box API selectors that expose neither weights nor gradients.
